Package dev.opencollab.paletter.item.component

Interface RepairAmount

All Known Implementing Classes:
RepairAmount.Expression, RepairAmount.Fixed
public sealed interface RepairAmount permits RepairAmount.Expression, RepairAmount.Fixed (not exhaustive)
The value of an add-on JSON field that takes one of several forms:
  • RepairAmount.Expression: a Molang expression for the amount
  • RepairAmount.Fixed: a fixed amount of durability

Bedrock may add forms, so a switch over it needs a default; the compiler enforces it (docs/api.md, "Evolution").

Used by: item:minecraft:repairable:repair_items[].repair_amount.

Since:
